title: ntlmssp: improve code readability with comments and constants aligned with spec
description:
When working on the `ntlmssp` code, I was slowed down because I feel like some parts were missing comments, or the constants were not named the same as in the \[MS-NLMP] Microsoft spec which is now available, or there were some dead-links or now better links.
Also I don't know why the code kept mentioning "**NT** password" instead of just "password", or "nt_password_hash" instead of just "nt_hash". It reads more natural this way IMO.
